  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  OCTOBER 8, 2024

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Brock at 4:33 p.m., on
  Tuesday, October 8, 2024, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Phil Brock
  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Christine Parra (Absent)
  Councilmember Caroline Torosis (Absent)
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick (Arrived at 5:24 p.m.)

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:34 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers Zwick, Parra, and Torosis.

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  No members of the public commented on Special Agenda items.
  SPECIAL AGENDA
  ITEMS ONLY:

  PROCLAMATIONS/  3.A.  Commendation: Margie Petersen Breast Center, was presented.
  COMMENDATIONS/
  SPECIAL AGENDA  3.B.  Commendation: The Acorn Store, was presented.
  ITEMS
  3.C.  Proclamation: Fire Prevention Week, was presented.
  (Councilmember Zwick
  arrived at 5:24 p.m.)  3.D.  Proclamation: Code Enforcement Officer Week, was presented.

  3.E. Proclamation: Disability Employment Awareness Month, was
  presented.

  3.F. Proclamation: Domestic Violence Awareness Month, was
  presented.

  3.G. State Legislative Update by Assemblymember Rick Chavez
  Zbur, was presented.

  1  October 8, 2024
 Docusign Envelope ID: CC8DBE4F-953D-4247-AB90-AE759F3F6762
